name: Burdening Cinch
description: Throw the loop over a walking neck and tighten it before the head can duck.

name: Noosebuckle
description: Flick the rim of the loop upward to tap aside a grasping hand.

name: Noosescorer
description: Close the distance in two steps and snap the pulled loop shut across the nape.

name: Tethering Constrict
description: Open the lead fist so the loop slides freely while the rear fist anchors the cord.

name: Lassoing Gripdowel
description: Feed qi into the loop so it keeps closing on its own while both hands turn to other work.

name: Barbedwire Hammerfall
description: Sway with the target's struggles while a steady qi pull drags the loop deeper beneath the jaw.

name: Guarding Cordbraid
description: Charge the cord with steady qi until it stands as a rigid bar against a club.

name: Levering Toggle
description: Spin a toggle once about the wrist and cast the loop at the target's neck.

name: Gripping Slipnoose
description: Hook the cord about an ankle with a low sweep and tug the foot out from under.

name: Slinking Throttle
description: Step backward on a long diagonal, dragging the target after the loop.

name: Lurching Tighten
description: Saw the charged cord across the soft tissue beside the windpipe.

name: Unmoving Handlebar
description: Roll the cord over the opposing wrist to turn aside a grab at the throat.

name: Ruthless Wirebraid
description: Hum qi down the taut cord so its vibration saps the target's grip strength.

name: Rough Slipknot
description: Whip the free tail around the target's guard and snap it back against the exposed ear.

name: Sturdy Wirecore
description: Stand with the cord at constant tension across the body so a rush meets a bar of hemp.

name: Tighten Glide
description: Dive under a swing and pull the cord taut again as you rise behind the striker.

name: Noosering Barrier
description: Release a clutched loop and throw a fresh one over the same arm in one motion.

name: Gagging Garrote
description: Haul the target in hand over hand, shortening the cord until their back meets your chest.

name: Harsh Throttle
description: Slap the stretched cord against the inside of a knee to buckle the leg.

name: Slipknot Scorer
description: Raise the qi in the cord one measured rung at a time as the target tires.

name: Noosescreen
description: Go slack as the target heaves, then snap the cord back to throw them off their own strike.

name: Draught Wirecore
description: Jab the pointed toggle tip into a nerve below the target's ribs.

name: Claytoggle
description: Fan both toggles to the sides so the cord forms a taut screen before the chest.

name: Rilltoggle
description: Catch an incoming wrist in the hooked toggle and twist it past the body.

name: Sprigtoggle
description: Throw a running loop that tightens itself as the target pulls away.

name: Lithe Toggle
description: Pivot on one toggle hand to walk in an arc past the target's shoulder.

name: Tethering Cordhandle
description: Spin the handles to reverse the loop's twist and lock the target's wrist the other way.

name: Splice Garrote
description: Fix a toggle to the belt with qi so the pull continues with both hands free.

name: Splice Slipnoose
description: Weave the cord between both handles in flowing loops that trap each limb the target offers.

name: Static Cinch
description: Drive qi through the toggle and knock it against the collarbone so the shock rings through the shoulder.

name: Wireswerve
description: Approach along the shaded edge of a lane and keep the cord out of the light.

name: Brassnoose
description: Hide the cord inside a sleeve fold, ready to draw, while the other hand shows empty.

name: Sprig Cordbraid
description: Reach over a seated target's shoulder and drop the loop onto the neck.

name: Purpose Barbedwire
description: Draw the loop taut so slowly that no gasp or rasp can alert anyone nearby.

name: Veering Noosering
description: Muffle each footfall in a skin of qi so the stalk makes no sound on stone.

name: Gap Wirebraid
description: Feel the target's pulse through a loop resting on the neck and time the draw to the pause between beats.

name: Brass Gripdowel
description: Whip both arms backward in one sharp draw so the loop bites at the top of the spine.

name: Cinchstalk
description: Thrust the rear hip into the target's back to unbalance them as the loop closes.

name: Weighty Cordhandle
description: Hook the loop under a collar and pull the target's chin up and back.

name: Wirescreen
description: Bar the cord across both palms to stop a forearm that drives at the face.

name: Poisenoose
description: Lift a shoulder and roll under the target's grabbing arm while keeping the cord taut.

name: Togglehasp
description: Drop a knee onto the back of the target's thigh to hold them while the loop tightens.

name: Momentstrand
description: Pull in short even beats rather than one long haul, leaving the target no time to breathe.

name: Swift Handlebar
description: Back each heave with a surge of qi from the lower back so the cord seems to double its force.

name: Viselike Toggle
description: Arch the spine and lift the target off the ground by the loop while qi keeps the cord from slipping.

name: Hungry Noosering
description: Rebound off a struggling target's pull to whip the free toggle against the opposite flank.

name: Claynoose
description: Stand in a wide stance with the cord drawn taut across the body like a bar.

name: Honedstrand
description: Square the hips to the target and snap the cord taut against a raised collar.

name: Stampwire
description: Capture a striking wrist in a cord turn and pull the arm across the target's own body.

name: Grit Gripdowel
description: Cast the loop on the forward step so the cord and the foot land together.

name: Toggleprop
description: Let the cord slip along a spear shaft and turn the head off to the side.

name: Sprig Barbedwire
description: Keep a closed loop on the neck and steer the target with the cord like a rein.

name: Clay Handlebar
description: Draw qi through both arms in even measure, holding the pull steady for long moments without shaking.

name: Weighty Constrict
description: Spin the neck loop on its rein to wheel the target into the path of a second foe.

name: Cometnoose
description: Hook the wire under a tucked chin and lever the head up and open.

name: Gleam Cordbraid
description: Slip a stiffened wire between a gorget's edge and the neck before the guard drops.

name: Padded Wirecore
description: Clamp the cord against the ribs and use an elbow to turn a grappling arm aside.

name: Brawn Slipknot
description: Enter at a side angle where a helm's brim blocks the target's vision.

name: Shard Gripdowel
description: Bend the wire into a short springing guard and release it against a thrusting hand.

name: Blank Wirebraid
description: Stiffen the wire with qi so it can pass through a gap in armor no wider than a finger.

name: Levering Throttle
description: Draw the wire along an armor seam until it holds the head fast in the neck opening.
